messages:
Renee: Quick sync — HelioBank POC goes live 09:00 local. They want a short handoff: reserved GPU count, AZ split, autoscale policy for 2-6m spikes, preheat checklist, and a clear line about quantized runtime licensing.
Omar: Traffic sketch?
Renee: SRE notes: steady 170 qps embeddings + 60 qps gen; spikes to ~1.0k qps for 3-6 minutes, usually twice daily. 95p embed latency target 140ms. Business-hours SLA Mon-Fri.
Sonal: Ballpark reserve = steady + 25% -> round to 3 reserved A100-eq. Recommend autoscale ceiling 6 with burst credits.
Grant: They asked for AZ spread. Recommend symmetric 2+1 if budget constrained, 2+2 for symmetric failover. Call out degraded 95p when failover triggers.
Renee: Need a tiny preheat runbook they can paste into the questionnaire.
Sonal: Use this short runbook (copyable): 1) schedule preheat 30m before peak; 2) run KV replay at ~30% expected peak for 5m; 3) run synthetic soak at 50% for 5m; 4) confirm KV hit-rate >= 80%; if fail, enable burst credits and contact Redwood oncall.
Omar: Autoscale snippet to paste into their ops ticket:
```json
{"autoscale":{"min_reserved_gpus":"3","max_gpus":"6","scale_step":"1","cooldown_s":"180","preheat_window_mins":"30","burst_credit_mode":"enabled","burst_qps_cap":"1400"}}
```
Grant: Note: cooldown 180s to avoid oscillation during short spikes. Also enforce per-customer burst cap to prevent noisy-neighbor issues.
Sonal: Licensing: quantized runtime is included in platform fee; legal prefers the explicit line: "Redwood's quantized inference runtime is provided as part of the platform services; no separate runtime license applies."
Renee: Pricing ask: they want a blended reserved+burst quote. Presales rule: reserved = monthly commit rate; burst credits sold in hour blocks at incremental rate; cross-AZ reserved carries a small infra surcharge. Omar, can you supply numbers?
Omar: I'll pull the template and post pricing blocks after this thread.
Grant: Observability checklist for their security form: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, KV hit-rate, preheat job logs, and audit trail for who triggered preheat. All exposed in Console and via API; metrics aggregated and PII redacted.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC — schedule preheat outside this window. :warning:
Renee: Good catch. We'll move preheat earlier. Action items: (1) Renee drafts one-pager with sizing rationale + autoscale snippet + preheat checklist + pricing bullets + license line (2) Omar to add pricing numbers (3) Grant to attach KV warmup script and small load-gen sample (4) Sonal to update questionnaire text. Aim to send to HelioBank in 2 hours. :rocket:
